stories.h: Nigerians rally around Mrs Gertrude Anulika Ngwu after humiliating incident at husband's Ozo title-taking ceremony
stories.p: Well-wishers have been visiting Mrs Gertrude Anulika Ngwu with gifts, money and encouragement after a viral video showed her co-wife's children refusing to spray money on her at her husband's Ozo title ceremony. Her story has reopened a conversation about how childless women are treated in some Nigerian families.
body: What was supposed to be a day of celebration has turned into a story of humiliation, public sympathy and unexpected kindness for Mrs Gertrude Anulika Ngwu, whose experience at her husband's Ozo title-taking ceremony has drawn wide attention on social media.

Kind-hearted Nigerians have continued to visit her, offering financial help, gifts and words of encouragement after a viral video showed her being treated in a way many viewers described as humiliating.
## The viral video

The video captured an uncomfortable moment during the traditional ceremony when the children of her husband's second wife reportedly refused to spray money on her, despite repeated appeals from the master of ceremonies.
According to accounts shared alongside the footage, the children had earlier sprayed money on their biological mother. When the MC encouraged them to do the same for Mrs Anulika, they declined.

For many Nigerians who watched, it was a painful scene: a woman attending an important ceremony in her husband's life, yet appearing to be left out of a celebration in which she should have felt included and respected.
## Years of mockery
The story became even more emotional following claims that Mrs Anulika had endured years of mockery over her inability to have children.

Reports online suggest she eventually moved back to her father's home after allegedly facing repeated ridicule from her co-wife and the woman's children. These allegations have not been independently verified.
## Strangers show her love
Nigerians who were touched by her story have decided to show her some love. In recent days, well-wishers have visited her at her father's residence with gifts, financial support and encouragement.

Some supporters have donated hundreds of thousands of naira, while others bought her a new mobile phone. More visits are planned: one support group has announced a grand visit to her village in Ukeh, Enugu State, on Friday, 6 November 2026, with supporters from Anambra, Imo and Abia invited to meet at Ekochin Bus Stop, 9th Mile.

Perhaps that is the most touching part of this story. People who have never met Mrs Anulika are going out of their way to make her smile. Strangers who watched a few minutes of her experience online have become concerned about her welfare.
## A conversation about childlessness
Her story has also reopened an important conversation about how women who struggle with childlessness are treated in some Nigerian families.

Why should a woman's value in marriage be measured by the number of children she has? Why should a woman who has spent years in a marriage be made to feel less important simply because she has not given birth?
Marriage comes with its own difficulties, but no woman deserves to be publicly ridiculed or denied basic respect because of her circumstances.
## Compassion still lives

Whatever may have happened behind the scenes in this family, the incident has clearly touched a nerve. The growing support for Mrs Anulika shows that compassion still has a place in society. Even at a time when many people are struggling financially, some are willing to share what little they have to comfort someone they believe has been treated unfairly.

One can only hope the support continues beyond social media and that she finds lasting peace, dignity and happiness. To every Nigerian who has visited, donated or offered her a kind word, your gesture deserves recognition. Sometimes, all a person needs is to know that somebody cares.
## Over to you

Should a woman who has no biological children be treated differently in her husband's family, especially when he marries another wife who has children? What happened to compassion, fairness and respect in our traditional family system?
more: Her co-wife's children reportedly refused to spray money on her.

stories.h: Power outages hit Lagos, Abuja and three other states as government blames gas shortages
stories.p: Residents of Lagos, Abuja, Ogun, Kwara and Oyo are facing worsening power cuts. Power Minister Joseph Tegbe has reportedly blamed gas shortages, maintenance work and low water levels at hydro plants, saying there has been no national grid collapse.
body: Electricity consumers in Lagos, Abuja, Ogun, Kwara and Oyo states are facing renewed power outages, prompting the federal government to explain the situation.
## What the minister said

Minister of Power Joseph Tegbe reportedly blamed the drop in supply on gas shortages, maintenance problems and reduced generation from hydropower plants because of low water levels, according to reports on Thursday, 5 November 2026. The government said there had been no major collapse of the national grid. It also said it had cleared 44 containers of equipment that had been stranded at the ports, which are needed to improve supply.
## Impact on customers

The outages have caused particular anger among Band A customers, who pay the highest tariffs in return for at least 20 hours of electricity a day. Ikeja Electric this week issued seven apologies in nine days for failing to meet that promise. Many households and businesses have had to spend more on fuel for generators.
## Background

Nigeria's electricity supply has long been unreliable, with generation often far below demand for a population of more than 200 million. Gas supply problems, vandalism of pipelines and weak transmission infrastructure are frequent causes. The government says it is working to expand generation and transmission capacity, while critics, including opposition candidates, say progress has been too slow. Electricity is expected to be a major issue in the 2027 campaign.
## What happens next
Consumers are waiting for a clear timeline from the government and distribution companies on when supply will improve.

stories.h: Funke Akindele's 'The Four' sells out London premiere at Odeon Leicester Square
stories.p: The London premiere of Funke Akindele's new film 'The Four' at the Odeon Luxe Leicester Square on 29 November has sold out, its distributor says. Akindele called it a historic moment for Nigerian cinema.
body: Funke Akindele's new film, 'The Four', has sold out its London premiere ahead of its release in Nigerian cinemas.
## The premiere

The film's distributor, FilmOne Entertainment, announced on Thursday, 5 November 2026, that tickets for the premiere at the Odeon Luxe Leicester Square, one of London's most famous cinemas, were no longer available. The premiere is scheduled for 29 November. Akindele had earlier described the event as a historic moment for Nigerian cinema.
## Background

Akindele is Nollywood's most commercially successful filmmaker, with several of her films topping the Nigerian box office, including 'Battle on Buka Street', 'A Tribe Called Judah' and 'Everybody Loves Jenifa'. 'A Tribe Called Judah' became the first Nollywood film to earn more than ₦1 billion at the box office. 'The Four' features several well-known actors, including Wumi Toriola, and is expected in Nigerian cinemas in December, traditionally the busiest period for local releases.
## Why it matters
A sold-out premiere at a major London venue shows the growing international audience for Nollywood films, particularly among the Nigerian diaspora in the UK.
## How fans reacted
Fans congratulated the actress and said they could not wait for the film's release in Nigeria.
more: The premiere at Odeon Luxe Leicester Square is on 29 November.
Tickets have sold out.
The film opens in Nigerian cinemas in December.

stories.h: Toyin Abraham issues cease-and-desist notice to bloggers over 'false' posts
stories.p: Actress Toyin Abraham's lawyer has issued a cease-and-desist notice warning bloggers, influencers and social media users to stop circulating claims she says are false and damaging, and to remove existing posts or face legal action.
body: Nollywood actress and filmmaker Toyin Abraham has warned bloggers and social media users that she will take legal action over publications she considers false and damaging.
## The notice

On Thursday, 5 November 2026, the actress shared on X a cease-and-desist notice issued by her lawyer, Tope Salami, according to reports. The notice, addressed to the general public and particularly bloggers, content creators and influencers, demanded that people stop circulating unverified claims about her and remove existing posts. It warned that digital materials could be used as evidence in possible court proceedings. The notice did not specify which posts or claims it was referring to.
## Background

Toyin Abraham has been the subject of much online discussion in recent weeks, including over a reported rift with fellow actress Funke Akindele after an old TikTok collaboration resurfaced. This week she also asked fans to call her by her former name, Toyin Aimakhu, as she promotes her new film 'Bestie', which is due in cinemas in December. Several celebrities, including Senator Ned Nwoko on behalf of Regina Daniels, have recently threatened legal action against people spreading false stories online.
## How people reacted
Some fans backed her decision, saying celebrities deserve protection from lies, while others said public figures should expect criticism.
more: Her lawyer issued the notice on 5 November.

stories.h: UK says Putin will not be invited to 2027 G20 summit, breaking with Trump
stories.p: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has reportedly said Russian President Vladimir Putin will not attend the G20 summit the UK hosts in Manchester in November 2027, because of sanctions. President Trump has invited Putin to this year's G20 in Miami.
body: The United Kingdom says it will not invite Russian President Vladimir Putin to the G20 summit it is hosting in 2027, setting it apart from the United States.
## What was said

In an interview reported on Thursday, 5 November 2026, Prime Minister Andy Burnham was reportedly asked whether Putin would be invited to the summit in Manchester in November 2027, and replied that he would not. He said the guest list was handled by the G20, but that Putin would not be coming because of an outstanding sanction.
## A contrast with Washington
President Donald Trump has invited Putin to this year's G20 summit in Miami in December. The Kremlin has not confirmed whether the Russian leader will attend.
## Background

Britain has avoided direct engagement with Russian ministers since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, and has imposed wide sanctions on Russian officials. Tensions over Russia's role in the G20 were on display at a meeting of foreign ministers in October, when a planned group photo was cancelled after European ministers refused to pose with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov. The G20 includes the world's largest economies, and the African Union became a full member in 2023.
## Why it matters
The disagreement highlights divisions among Western allies over how to deal with Russia as the war in Ukraine continues.
more: Burnham says Putin will not attend the 2027 Manchester summit.

Trump has invited Putin to the Miami G20 in December.

stories.h: Nicki Minaj tells critics 'Trump is still your President' after Democrats' midterm win
stories.p: Rapper Nicki Minaj has reportedly posted a list of messages backing President Trump after the Democrats won control of Congress, praising JD Vance and Elon Musk and urging Republicans to wake up.
body: American rapper Nicki Minaj has doubled down on her support for President Donald Trump after his party's heavy losses in the US midterm elections.
## What she posted

In a series of posts on X on Wednesday night, 4 November 2026, Minaj reportedly shared a numbered list of messages, declaring that Trump is still the president and, in a reference to herself, that 'the Queen' is still people's obsession. She also praised Vice President JD Vance, congratulated Republican winners including Florida's governor-elect Byron Donalds, described Elon Musk as a trillionaire and urged Republicans to wake up. She thanked her fans, known as the Barbz, and shared a video responding to criticism of her support for Trump.
## Background

The Democrats are projected to have won control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate in the 3 November midterms, in a result widely seen as a rebuke of Trump's second-term agenda. Trump said he was not on the ballot and later admitted the Iran war had contributed to the losses. Minaj, who was born in Trinidad and Tobago, has in recent years become an outspoken supporter of Trump, which has divided her fan base.
## How people reacted
Her posts drew mixed reactions, with some fans applauding her and others criticising her political views.
more: Minaj posted a list backing Trump after the midterms.
She praised JD Vance and Elon Musk.
The Democrats are projected to control Congress.

stories.h: Apostle Suleman says he tested Nathaniel Bassey with money, and was impressed
stories.p: Apostle Johnson Suleman has reportedly told his church that he once offered gospel singer Nathaniel Bassey money to test his character before a convention, and that Bassey's response taught him a lesson about humility and spiritual covering.
body: Apostle Johnson Suleman, founder of Omega Fire Ministries, has shared a story about gospel singer Nathaniel Bassey that has drawn wide attention.
## What he said

Speaking during a Sunday service, in comments shared this week, Suleman reportedly said he first met Bassey on a plane ahead of his church's convention. According to him, Bassey said he wanted to attend the convention not as a paid performer but to support his spiritual father, whom Suleman named as Pastor Deboye. Curious about his reasons, Suleman said he deliberately offered the singer money to see how he would respond, as a way of studying his character and values.
## The response
Suleman said Bassey's response left him with a powerful lesson about mentorship and respect for spiritual leaders, though reports did not detail exactly what the singer said.
## Background

Nathaniel Bassey is one of Africa's most popular gospel ministers and recently became the first African gospel artist to reach 1 billion views on YouTube. He is known for his worship sessions and the annual Hallelujah Challenge. Suleman is a prominent and sometimes controversial Pentecostal preacher based in Auchi, Edo State.
## How people reacted
Many Christians praised Bassey's humility, while others debated whether it was right to test someone with money.
more: Suleman says he offered Bassey money to test him.
Bassey wanted to attend the convention to support his spiritual father.
Suleman says the response taught him a lesson.

stories.h: Kwara South Senator Saliu Mustapha earns degree from UK university
stories.p: Senator Saliu Mustapha, who represents Kwara South, has announced that he has earned a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration and Finance from Arden University in the UK, describing education as a lifelong journey.
body: The senator representing Kwara South, Saliu Mustapha, has announced the completion of a degree from a British university.
## What he announced

In a social media post on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, Mustapha said he had earned a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration and Finance from Arden University in the United Kingdom. He described it as a proud personal milestone, thanked God and said he had always believed education is a lifelong journey that opens doors regardless of a person's age or status.
## Background

Mustapha, a member of the All Progressives Congress, was elected senator for Kwara South in 2023. Arden University offers degree programmes largely through online and blended learning, which allows working adults to study part-time. The academic qualifications of Nigerian politicians often attract public interest, with debates this week over President Bola Tinubu's university record and Education Minister Tunji Alausa's claim that the President graduated with a first class.
## How people reacted
Many people congratulated the senator and praised him for setting an example of continued learning, while others questioned how he combined his studies with his legislative duties.
more: He earned a BA in Business Administration and Finance.
The degree is from Arden University in the UK.
He says education is a lifelong journey.

stories.h: Police arrest man known as 'General Don' over alleged impersonation of soldiers in Ogun
stories.p: Ogun State police say they have arrested a man known as 'General Don' for allegedly impersonating military personnel. A military cap, trousers and photos of him in uniform were reportedly recovered.
body: Police in Ogun State have arrested a man popularly known as 'General Don' on suspicion of impersonating military personnel.
## The arrest

In a statement by police spokesperson DSP Oluseyi Babaseyi, the Ogun State Police Command said operatives of its Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) unit arrested the suspect at about 2am on 3 November 2026 in Kajola, Elega, Abeokuta. The command said the arrest followed intelligence from a community leader and discreet surveillance. Items recovered reportedly included a military cap, military-style trousers and four photographs of the suspect in military uniform.
## What the police said

Commissioner of Police Bode Ojajuni said the command remains committed to tackling impersonation and other crimes, and urged residents to report suspicious behaviour. The police said investigations were continuing to establish the circumstances of the alleged impersonation and whether others were involved. The suspect has not yet been charged in court.
## Background

Impersonating security personnel is a criminal offence in Nigeria. Fake soldiers and police officers have been used in robberies, extortion and other crimes, and security agencies regularly warn the public to verify the identity of anyone claiming to be an officer.
## How people reacted
Many social media users mocked the nickname and praised the community leader who alerted the police.
more: The suspect was arrested in Abeokuta on 3 November.
Police recovered military items and photos.
Investigations are continuing.

stories.h: Tension erupts as angry crowd throws stones towards stage while Nasarawa governor addresses presidential campaign rally
stories.p: A presidential campaign rally was disrupted when some angry youths in the crowd reportedly threw stones towards the stage as Nasarawa State Governor Abdullahi Sule addressed supporters. Photos show stones lying on the stage beside the governor and his team.
body: What was supposed to be a peaceful political campaign reportedly took a dramatic turn when some angry youths in the crowd began throwing stones towards the stage while Nasarawa State Governor Abdullahi Sule was addressing supporters.
## What happened
The incident happened during a presidential campaign rally on Thursday, 5 November 2026, and created tension at the venue as the gathering was disrupted.

Photos from the event show large stones lying on the red carpet of the stage, close to the governor's feet. In one image, a man in a suit bends to pick up one of the stones as the governor, microphone in hand, points towards the crowd, with security officers standing beside him.
## Why the anger?

The exact reason for the crowd's anger remains unclear. The incident does, however, raise questions about growing frustration among sections of the population and how political leaders are being received at public gatherings.
For many Nigerians struggling with the rising cost of living, unemployment and insecurity, political promises are becoming harder to accept without visible results.
Even so, it would be premature to blame those grievances for the disturbance without hearing from the people involved.
## Violence is never the answer

Whatever the reason, throwing stones at a political gathering is dangerous and should never be encouraged. People have every right to express their dissatisfaction with their leaders, but political disagreement should never turn violent.
## Over to you
Are Nigerian politicians beginning to face the anger and frustration of the people they have been making promises to for years?
more: Stones were thrown towards the stage during the governor's speech.
The reason for the crowd's anger is unclear.

stories.h: "I would have been worried if Amaechi stood a chance in Rivers State": Wike fires back at political rivals
stories.p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has dismissed Rotimi Amaechi's chances in Rivers State, insisting he remains a major force there even though he is no longer governor. He also claimed the APC barely existed in Rivers before he backed it, and that he has "killed the Obi wave" in the FCT.
body: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has once again spoken boldly about his political influence in Rivers State, dismissing the chances of former Minister of Transportation Rotimi Amaechi and insisting he remains a major force in the state.
## "You cannot wish me away"
According to Wike, he would only have reason to worry if Amaechi stood a realistic chance of a significant political comeback in Rivers State.
The former Rivers governor made it clear that leaving Government House in Port Harcourt has not reduced his influence or weakened the structures he built over the years.
"I am not a governor, I am a minister, but you cannot wish me away in Rivers State, because the people know what I stand for and because of the people I have raised," Wike said.
His statement appears to be a direct message to those who believe his appointment as FCT Minister has taken him away from the centre of Rivers politics.
## Claims about the APC
Wike also claimed that the All Progressives Congress (APC) had little political strength in Rivers State before he decided to support the party.
"Before I decided to support the APC, the party did not exist in Rivers State," he said.
That is a bold claim, given the long rivalry between Wike and Amaechi, who both served as governors of Rivers State at different times.
## "I have killed the Obi wave"
Wike did not limit his remarks to Rivers. He also turned his attention to the movement around NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi, claiming he had already weakened its influence in the FCT.
"As for the NDC, I have killed the Obi wave in the FCT," he said.
The remarks reflect Wike's confidence in his political strength, although his claims about the APC and about Obi's support remain his own assessment.
## The road to 2027

With the 2027 general elections approaching, the political battle in Rivers State is expected to draw even more attention. Wike, Amaechi and other influential figures may once again find themselves on opposing sides as parties prepare for another contest.
For now, Wike is making one thing clear to his opponents: he may no longer be governor, but he has no intention of surrendering his influence in Rivers State.
## Over to you
Is Wike still as politically powerful in Rivers State as he believes, or will the 2027 elections reveal a different picture?
more: Wike says Amaechi stands no real chance in Rivers.
He claims the APC barely existed in Rivers before he backed it.

stories.h: "If not for VeryDarkMan, I wouldn't be where I am today": Ratel Princess Jojooflele expresses gratitude from China
stories.p: Social media personality Jojooflele, known as the Ratel Princess, has publicly thanked VeryDarkMan for changing her life, saying her following and opportunities grew after she met him. She spoke from China, a long way from the Nedu controversy that first brought her into the spotlight.
body: Popular social media personality Jojooflele, widely known as the Ratel Princess, has openly expressed her appreciation for VeryDarkMan (VDM), acknowledging the role he has played in changing her life.
## "If not for VDM"
Speaking from China, Jojooflele reflected on how far she has come and how her association with VDM opened doors she probably never imagined would open so soon.
"If not for VDM, I wouldn't be where I am today," she said.

According to her, things took a completely different turn after she met VeryDarkMan. Her social media pages began attracting more attention, her followers increased, and opportunities started coming her way.
## How it all started

What makes her story even more interesting is how it began. Many will remember the controversy involving Nedu, when Jojooflele found herself at the centre of public attention, with people discussing her personal life and questioning her actions.
For someone else, that kind of controversy could have been enough to damage their confidence or push them off social media completely.

Instead, Jojooflele turned the attention into something positive. Rather than letting the controversy define her future, she kept building her presence online and eventually became a familiar face among supporters of the Ratel Movement.
## A lesson in gratitude
Today, she is in China, reflecting on her journey and publicly appreciating someone she believes contributed greatly to her success.
Jojooflele deserves credit for how she has handled her growing popularity. The right connections can open doors, but what you do with those opportunities matters just as much.

Her appreciation for VDM is also worth acknowledging. In a society where people sometimes forget those who supported them once they start to succeed, publicly recognising someone's contribution says a lot about gratitude.
## Setbacks are not the end

Perhaps the biggest lesson here is never to be too quick to conclude that your present difficulties will decide your future. The situation people expect to destroy you can end up introducing you to opportunities you never knew existed.
What looks like a setback today may become part of the story you proudly tell tomorrow.
## Over to you
What do you think about Jojooflele's journey from the Nedu controversy to her growing popularity and opportunities abroad?
more: Jojooflele credits VDM for changing her life.

stories.h: "My oga had nothing to do with any plot to arrest VeryDarkMan": Israel DMW defends Davido amid controversy
stories.p: Davido's aide Israel DMW has denied that the singer had any hand in an alleged plot to have VeryDarkMan arrested, or in Naira Marley's troubles during the Mohbad case. He says those who told VDM otherwise lied.
body: Davido's loyal aide, Israel DMW, has come out to defend his boss following speculation linking the Afrobeats superstar to an alleged plot to get social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) arrested.
## "Oga had no hands in it"
In a post addressed to "Dearest Nigerians", Israel said Davido had no hand in Naira Marley's ordeal during the Mohbad case, nor in any plot to see VDM arrested.
He said those who were in the WhatsApp group linked to the matter got there without Davido's instructions or approval, and that those who told VDM otherwise "fully lied".
## Sam Klef, Mohbad's catalogue and Zino
Israel also asked why Davido would have any issue with Sam Klef, and denied that the singer ever asked for Mohbad's music catalogue or tried to sign Zino.
## "Naira and oga are cool"

According to Israel, there was serious pressure on Davido at the time to unfollow Naira Marley on Instagram, but he categorically refused, saying he wanted the police to do their job and did not want to act on hearsay.
"Naira and oga are cool," he wrote, adding that the two even made a hit song together.
On an incident at Naira Marley's house, Israel said it involved Tolu 30BG, who had a disagreement with one of Naira's boys, and insisted that nobody was beaten or attacked.
## Why the denial matters

VDM is known for speaking openly about controversial issues and challenging influential people, which has earned him both strong supporters and fierce critics. Whenever the names Davido and VeryDarkMan appear in the same controversy, Nigerians are bound to have plenty to say.
Israel's message is straightforward: whatever controversy surrounds VDM, his boss should not be accused of involvement without proof.
It is important to note that the allegations remain unverified. Israel's denial is his own position, and there is no established evidence that Davido took part in any plot to have VDM arrested.
## Over to you

Who is actually behind the alleged move to arrest VeryDarkMan, and why is Davido's name being mentioned? Until credible evidence emerges, the public should be careful about turning social media speculation into fact.

stories.h: Bandits demand over ₦100 million for abducted Niger Islamiyya students, teacher says
stories.p: The teacher of the Islamiyya students abducted from his farm in Rafi, Niger State, says the kidnappers have demanded more than ₦100 million for their release. He said families have had little official help and called for military action.
body: The kidnappers of a group of Islamiyya students abducted in Niger State have demanded more than ₦100 million for their release, according to their teacher.
## What the teacher said

Malam Aminu Bako, whose students were taken while helping him harvest maize on his farm in Rafi Local Government Area, said on Thursday, 5 November 2026, that the bandits had contacted village leaders with the ransom demand. He said 15 children were abducted, and called for urgent military action to rescue them. According to him, only the acting chairman of the local government and the divisional police officer had visited since the abduction, and families were relying on local vigilantes to track the kidnappers.
## Where the children may be

Bako said information gathered by vigilantes suggests the children are still in Niger State, held in an isolated building guarded by heavily armed men, possibly without enough food. He said he was under intense pressure from worried parents.
## Background

The students were abducted on 31 October from a farm in Tungan-Bako village near Pandogari. Police at the time said 14 students were taken and that a joint security operation had been launched. Rafi and surrounding areas have suffered repeated attacks by armed groups, and kidnapping for ransom remains widespread in north-west and north-central Nigeria. Paying ransom is illegal in Nigeria, although families often feel they have no choice.
## What happens next
Families and community leaders are calling on the federal and state governments to step up efforts to rescue the children.
more: The kidnappers reportedly want over ₦100 million.

stories.h: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña resigns over bank collapse scandal
stories.p: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña has resigned after the lower house voted to begin impeachment proceedings over the collapse of a bank he was once linked to as a shareholder. He apologised to Paraguayans.
body: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña has resigned amid a political crisis caused by the collapse of a bank he was previously linked to.
## What happened

In a video message posted on X, Peña said he was stepping down to protect the country's stability and democratic institutions, a day after opposition lawmakers requested his impeachment and the lower house of Congress voted to begin proceedings, according to reports on Thursday, 5 November 2026. He apologised to the people if he had failed them at any point, saying it was never his intention to betray their trust.
## The bank collapse

The crisis began when Ueno Bank collapsed and froze its operations, reportedly leaving large numbers of customers unable to access their accounts. Lawmakers accused Peña of conflicts of interest, pointing to his past shareholding in the company that owned the bank.
## Background

Peña, an economist and former finance minister, took office in August 2023 as a member of the long-dominant Colorado Party. Under Paraguay's constitution, the vice-president takes over when a president leaves office before the end of the term.
## What happens next
Attention now turns to who will lead the country for the rest of the term, and to investigations into the bank's collapse and whether depositors will recover their money.
more: Peña resigned after impeachment proceedings began.
The crisis followed the collapse of Ueno Bank.
He apologised to Paraguayans.

stories.h: Sego declares end of feud with MC Oluomo after KWAM 1 steps in
stories.p: Lagos NURTW chairman Mustapha Sego has announced that his dispute with national president MC Oluomo is over, after Fuji star KWAM 1 reportedly brokered peace. The announcement came days after a court ordered Sego's arrest in a separate case.
body: The Lagos State chairman of the National Union of Road Transport Workers (NURTW), Mustapha Adekunle, known as Sego, has declared an end to his dispute with the union's national president, Musiliu Akinsanya, popularly known as MC Oluomo.
## What happened

In a video from a Lagos NURTW meeting on Thursday, 5 November 2026, Sego reportedly told members that the disagreement had ended. The announcement followed an intervention by Fuji music star Wasiu Ayinde Marshal, known as KWAM 1, who is said to have brokered peace between the two transport union leaders.
## Background

The NURTW is one of the most powerful unions in Lagos, controlling motor parks across the state, and its leaders are influential in local politics. MC Oluomo was previously chairman of the Lagos State Parks Management Committee before becoming national president of the union. Details of the dispute between him and Sego were not made public. Earlier this week, the National Industrial Court in Lagos ordered the arrest of Sego and the union's Lagos secretary for failing to appear in a contempt case linked to a dispute with tricycle operators. MC Oluomo also made headlines this week after saying he was taking adult English lessons.
## Why it matters
Peace between the two men is seen as important for stability in the union and in motor parks across Lagos, especially ahead of the 2027 elections.
more: Sego says his dispute with MC Oluomo is over.
KWAM 1 reportedly brokered peace.
A court ordered Sego's arrest this week in a separate case.

stories.h: Natasha Osawaru shows off NDC certificate of return for Edo Assembly seat
stories.p: Edo lawmaker Natasha Osawaru has shared her certificate of return as the Nigeria Democratic Congress candidate for Egor constituency in the 2027 Edo House of Assembly election, confirming her move from the PDP to the NDC.
body: Edo State lawmaker Natasha Irobosa Osawaru has confirmed her political plans for 2027, sharing her certificate of return as the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) candidate for Egor constituency.
## The certificate

In a social media post reported on Thursday, 5 November 2026, Osawaru displayed the certificate, dated 26 October 2026, which names her as the NDC's flag bearer for the Edo State House of Assembly seat representing Egor in the 2027 general election. The post confirmed her defection from the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) to the NDC, the party of presidential candidate Peter Obi.
## Background

Osawaru represents Egor in the Edo State House of Assembly. She is also widely known as the partner of singer 2Baba, with whom she has a son who recently turned one. Her relationship with the singer has drawn public attention since 2Baba's separation from his former wife, Annie. The NDC has attracted several defectors from the PDP and other parties ahead of the elections.
## How people reacted
Supporters congratulated her on securing the ticket, while some social media users debated her decision to switch parties.
more: Her certificate is dated 26 October 2026.
She is the NDC candidate for Egor in the Edo Assembly.
She moved from the PDP to the NDC.

stories.h: Ekene Umenwa kneels in joy as husband gifts her a Lexus on third anniversary
stories.p: Actress Ekene Umenwa was overwhelmed when her husband, Kleanson, surprised her with a new Lexus SUV at their Asaba home to mark their third wedding anniversary. She thanked him in an emotional message.
body: Nollywood actress Ekene Umenwa received a big surprise from her husband to mark their third wedding anniversary.
## What happened

In a video shared online on Thursday, 5 November 2026, her husband, Kleanson, presented her with a ribbon-wrapped black Lexus SUV, along with gift boxes and paperwork, at their home in Asaba, Delta State. The actress dropped to her knees in gratitude as she took in the surprise.
## Her message
In a post celebrating the anniversary, Ekene thanked her husband for loving her and spoke about love, grace and the choice to keep choosing each other every day.
## Background
Ekene Umenwa is a popular Nollywood actress and producer who has appeared in many films. She married Kleanson in 2023 and often shares moments from their marriage with fans online.
## How people reacted

Fans and colleagues flooded her post with congratulations and prayers for the couple. Some social media users debated whether such public displays of gifts put pressure on other couples, while many simply celebrated with her.
more: Her husband gave her a black Lexus SUV.
The surprise was at their home in Asaba.
Fans congratulated the couple.

stories.h: NAPTIP warns traffickers are luring victims at gyms and with fake jobs
stories.p: The anti-trafficking agency NAPTIP has warned that human traffickers are approaching women at gyms and social venues, posing as helpful service providers and offering fake jobs to win their trust.
body: The National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons (NAPTIP) has warned Nigerians about new tactics used by human traffickers to recruit victims.
## What NAPTIP said

Speaking at a joint briefing by security and intelligence agencies in Abuja on Thursday, 5 November 2026, NAPTIP spokesman Adekoye Vincent said traffickers are increasingly exploiting social relationships, especially with women. He said they approach people at gyms, recreational centres and other social venues, first presenting themselves as service providers offering help with domestic needs, shopping or sourcing goods. Once they have built trust and familiarity, they lure victims with fake job offers and other promises.
## Advice to the public

The agency urged Nigerians, particularly young women, to be cautious about strangers offering help or opportunities that seem too good to be true, to verify job offers, and to report suspicious approaches to the authorities.
## Background

Nigeria is a major source, transit and destination country for human trafficking, with victims taken to other African countries, Europe and the Middle East for forced labour and sexual exploitation. This week, police in Mali rescued Nigerian women from a trafficking ring. NAPTIP has long warned that traffickers use fake job offers abroad, and more recently social media, to recruit victims.
## Why it matters
Officials say awareness is one of the best defences against traffickers, who constantly change their methods.
more: Traffickers are approaching women at gyms and social venues.
They pose as helpful service providers before offering fake jobs.
NAPTIP urged people to verify offers and report suspicions.

stories.h: Peter Obi condemns court ruling nullifying ADC chairman, says ruling party is engineering instability
stories.p: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi has condemned a Federal High Court ruling in Abuja that nullified the emergence of the ADC national chairman and all his actions. Obi warned the ruling could create serious uncertainty for opposition parties ahead of 2027, and accused the ruling party of engineering it.
body: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi has condemned the Federal High Court ruling that nullified the emergence of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) national chairman and the actions taken under his leadership.
## "Do not undermine democracy"
In a statement on X titled "Do not Undermine Democracy", Obi said he received the news of the order by the Federal High Court in Abuja "with shock", describing it as "unsettling and surprising".
He was careful to say he was not challenging the court itself. "I do not challenge the ruling of the court. The court of law is constituted to determine disputes according to the law," he wrote.
## Uncertainty before 2027

Obi's concern, he explained, is the timing. "My concern is that three months before a general election, it is in the public interest to have certainty. It is not good to have too many uncertainties about candidates and parties a few weeks before a presidential election."
## Accusation against the ruling party

He went further, alleging that the instability was "obviously engineered by the ruling party, just as they have done against me in the Labour Party", and that the same approach was being used "to close down civic space for a robust campaign".
Obi also linked it to what he described as violence against opposition campaigns, saying it came "from the same rulebook that manufactures violence against us in our campaigns."
These are Obi's allegations, and the ruling party has not been quoted responding to them in his statement.
## A call to the judiciary
Obi called on the judiciary to rise up and protect democracy by making sure opposition parties and their candidates are allowed to take part freely in the electoral process.
## Over to you
Is Obi right to worry about the timing of the ruling, or should the court's decision simply be allowed to take its course?
more: A Federal High Court nullified the ADC chairman's emergence.
Obi says the ruling creates uncertainty three months before the election.
He accused the ruling party of engineering instability.
stories.alt: Peter Obi and Atiku Abubakar beside a screenshot of Obi's statement on X titled Do not Undermine Democracy

stories.h: NDC takes Lagos by storm as large crowd turns out for campaign
stories.p: The National Democratic Coalition (NDC) has taken its campaign to Lagos, drawing a large crowd of supporters. The turnout in one of Nigeria's biggest political battlegrounds has raised the question of whether the party can turn enthusiasm into votes in 2027.
body: The National Democratic Coalition (NDC) has taken its political campaign to Lagos, and judging by the crowd that turned out, the party appears determined to make its presence felt ahead of the 2027 general elections.
## A charged atmosphere

The atmosphere was charged with excitement as supporters gathered to welcome the campaign team. Photos from the event show party leaders addressing the crowd, and streets packed with supporters, many in red caps, cheering and holding up their phones.
For a party seeking to establish itself as a serious political force, such a turnout could be an encouraging sign.
## Why Lagos matters
This is Lagos, a state widely regarded as one of Nigeria's most important political battlegrounds and a stronghold of President Bola Tinubu's political influence.
Taking a campaign into Lagos and drawing a large crowd is bound to generate political discussion, especially as opposition parties begin positioning themselves for 2027.
## Crowds versus votes
The real question goes beyond the number of people who attended. Can the NDC turn the enthusiasm at its campaign into actual votes when Nigerians return to the polling units?
Nigeria has seen massive political rallies before, only for the election results to tell a different story.
Still, one thing is becoming clear. The political atmosphere ahead of 2027 is gradually heating up, and Lagos will remain a major battleground.
## Over to you
Is the crowd at the NDC campaign a sign of growing political support, or is it too early to draw conclusions?
more: The NDC drew a large crowd at its Lagos campaign.
Lagos is a key battleground and Tinubu's stronghold.
Crowds do not always translate into votes.
stories.alt: NDC leaders addressing supporters with a microphone, above photos of a large cheering crowd, many wearing red caps

stories.h: "Her own papa?!": Rudeboy reacts in disbelief as young lady blames mother for marrying a broke man
stories.p: Singer Paul Okoye, popularly known as Rudeboy, has expressed shock over a viral video of a young lady who blamed her mother for marrying a man who was not financially successful: her own father. The clip has sparked a wider debate about money, marriage and what children expect of their parents.
body: Nigerian singer Paul Okoye, popularly known as Rudeboy, has expressed shock over a viral video of a young lady who reportedly blamed her mother for marrying a man who was not financially successful.
## Rudeboy's reaction

Reacting to the video on his Instagram story, Rudeboy could hardly believe what he was hearing. "Imagine a daughter blaming her own mother for marrying down, as in marrying a broke man! As in her father! Her own papa!" he wrote.
It is easy to see why the statement caught his attention. Imagine growing up, looking at your parents, and deciding your mother made a terrible mistake simply because your father was not rich.
## Social media reacts
The young lady's remarks have stirred plenty of reactions, with many Nigerians asking how someone could speak so openly about her own father's financial situation.

Some believe her comments reflect a growing obsession with money and luxury among young people. Others argue that children who grow up in financial hardship may develop resentment towards their parents, especially when they see other families living more comfortably.

Some social media users have even joked that they will save the video and wait to see the kind of wealthy man she eventually marries. Since she believes her mother chose poorly, they say, the public will be interested to see whether she makes a better choice when her own time comes.
One thing about social media is that people rarely forget statements like this. Years from now, someone may dig up the same video and remind her of what she said about her parents.
## The other side
Nobody chooses the circumstances they are born into, and wanting a better life is perfectly understandable. But does that justify publicly blaming a parent for not marrying someone wealthy?
Marriage itself is unpredictable. A man can be comfortable today and lose everything tomorrow, while another can start with almost nothing and become successful years later.
That is why Rudeboy's reaction has become part of a much bigger conversation about money, marriage, parental sacrifice and the expectations children place on their parents.
## Over to you
Is the young lady wrong for blaming her mother, or is she simply expressing the frustration of growing up in a financially struggling home?
more: A young lady blamed her mother for marrying a broke man, her father.
Rudeboy reacted in disbelief on Instagram.
The clip has sparked debate about money and marriage.
stories.alt: Rudeboy Paul Okoye, a young lady speaking in a video, and a screenshot of Rudeboy's Instagram story reacting

stories.h: VDM says his friendship with Davido began and ended over the fight for Mohbad
stories.p: VeryDarkMan says the campaign for justice for the late singer Mohbad brought him and Davido together, and later drove them apart. He said Davido followed him in early 2024 and they became friends before things changed.
body: Social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) has given his account of how his friendship with Davido broke down.
## What he said

In a video released on Thursday, 5 November 2026, VDM said the same issue that brought them together eventually tore them apart: the campaign for justice for the late singer Mohbad. He recalled that he became heavily involved in demanding answers after Mohbad's death in September 2023, when questions about the circumstances of the death and the singer's earlier complaints about his former record label drew huge public attention. VDM said Davido followed him on social media in early 2024, which excited him, and that they became friends, with VDM supporting and promoting some of the singer's music. He said their relationship later changed, with the Mohbad matter at the heart of the fallout.
## The current feud

The explanation comes amid an escalating public feud. This week VDM dared Davido's camp to show proof that the singer ever helped him financially, warned Zlatan Ibile after Davido was filmed singing along to Zlatan's song 'Inferno', and released a preview of his own diss track aimed at Davido. Several celebrities, including Oyemykke and Roskey, have weighed in.
## Background

Mohbad, whose real name was Ilerioluwa Aloba, died in Lagos in September 2023 at the age of 27. His death led to protests and a police investigation, and a coroner's inquest was held into the circumstances.
## How people reacted
Fans were divided, with some saying VDM's account explained the bitterness, and others urging both men to end the public quarrel.
more: VDM says the Mohbad campaign brought them together.
He says Davido followed him in early 2024.
The feud has escalated this week.
stories.alt: VeryDarkMan

stories.h: Anambra NDC sets target of 98% of votes for Peter Obi
stories.p: The Nigeria Democratic Congress in Anambra has inaugurated a campaign council for Peter Obi and set a target of 98% of the state's votes, or about 1.5 million, up from about 600,000 votes he won there in 2023. A homecoming rally is planned.
body: The Anambra State chapter of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) has set an ambitious target for its presidential candidate, Peter Obi, in the 2027 election.
## The target

At the inauguration of the state campaign council for the Obi–Kwankwaso ticket in Awka on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, state party chairman Ikem Uzoezie reportedly said the party aims to win 98 per cent of the votes cast in Anambra, about 1.5 million votes. That would be well above the roughly 600,000 votes Obi received in the state in 2023, when he ran on the Labour Party platform.
## Campaign team
Former federal lawmaker Ifeanyi Ibezi was named state campaign coordinator. He promised a major homecoming rally for Obi in the coming weeks.
## Background

Obi governed Anambra from 2006 to 2014 and remains popular in the state, which he won by a wide margin in 2023. Anambra's current governor, Charles Soludo of APGA, has said he backs President Bola Tinubu, while describing Obi as a close family friend. The APC is also campaigning hard in the South East, where several governors have declared support for the President. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
## How people reacted
Obi's supporters welcomed the target as a sign of confidence, while rivals said the figure was unrealistic and that voters would decide.
more: The target is about 1.5 million votes.
Obi won about 600,000 votes in Anambra in 2023.
A homecoming rally is planned.
stories.credit: Photo: VOA / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain
stories.alt: Peter Obi

stories.h: Wike says Fubara is a young man whose political future is not over
stories.p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has said Rivers governor Siminalayi Fubara is still young and could become a minister in future, dismissing suggestions that his political career will end when he leaves office.
body: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has spoken about the political future of Rivers State governor Siminalayi Fubara.
## What he said

Responding to questions at his monthly media chat in Abuja on Thursday, 5 November 2026, Wike reportedly said Fubara is a young man and cannot say his political future is gone. He said that not being a minister today does not mean he will not be one tomorrow.
## Background

Fubara succeeded Wike as Rivers governor in 2023, but the two fell out soon afterwards, leading to a long political crisis in the state that included a period of emergency rule. The pair later reconciled, and Fubara has backed Wike's Rainbow Coalition supporting President Bola Tinubu's re-election. Fubara is not expected to seek a second term as governor in 2027, and Kingsley Chinda is the APC governorship candidate in the state, though a suit seeking to disqualify him is due for hearing on 10 December. At the same media chat, Wike denied any role in the court ruling that made Rochas Okorocha the APC's Imo West Senate candidate.
## Why it matters
Wike's comments suggest that Fubara may be offered a role in the federal government in future, as part of the political arrangements in Rivers.
## How people reacted
Supporters of both men welcomed the comments, while critics said Rivers politics was being decided by a few powerful figures.
more: Wike says Fubara's political future is not over.
He suggested Fubara could become a minister.
The two men reconciled after a long crisis.

stories.h: Patoranking contrasts peaceful US midterms with Nigerian elections
stories.p: Singer Patoranking has praised the peaceful conduct of the US midterm elections, noting that nobody died and no ballot boxes were snatched, and said Nigerians have normalised bad behaviour in their elections.
body: Reggae-dancehall singer Patoranking has compared the recent US midterm elections with elections in Nigeria.
## What he said

In a post on X, reported on Thursday, 5 November 2026, the singer noted that nobody died during the American polls and there were no reports of ballot box snatching. He said Nigeria's problems have become so bad that citizens now accept bad behaviour as normal.
## Background

The US midterm elections on 3 November saw the Democrats projected to take control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate, with several historic firsts, including the first Muslim US senator. Midterms are held halfway through a president's four-year term and decide all 435 House seats and about a third of the Senate, as well as many state governorships. Nigeria's past elections have often been marred by violence and allegations of rigging, and attacks on campaign events have already been reported ahead of the January 2027 polls, including on Peter Obi's convoy in Calabar this week.
## How people reacted
Many fans agreed with the singer and called for peaceful and credible elections in 2027, while others pointed out that the US also has problems with its elections.
more: Patoranking praised the peaceful US midterms.
He said Nigerians have normalised bad electoral behaviour.
Attacks on campaign events have been reported in Nigeria.

stories.h: Kogi group defends Natasha Akpoti-Uduaghan after call for EFCC probe
stories.p: A group in Kogi Central has condemned calls by the Obi–Kwankwaso Movement for the EFCC to investigate Senator Natasha Akpoti-Uduaghan over a cash empowerment programme, saying the demand is politically motivated.
body: A political group in Kogi State has come to the defence of Senator Natasha Akpoti-Uduaghan after calls for the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) to investigate her.
## What happened

The Obi–Kwankwaso Movement had reportedly called on the EFCC to look into a cash empowerment programme organised by the senator, who represents Kogi Central. In a statement on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, the Kogi Central Progressive Elites, through its president, Abdullahi Omeiza, said the call was driven by political calculations rather than a genuine interest in accountability, and was aimed at limiting the senator's growing influence ahead of the 2027 elections. The group challenged the movement to submit any evidence to the appropriate authorities rather than make public declarations. The EFCC has not said whether it has received or acted on any petition.
## Background

Akpoti-Uduaghan, a senator since 2023, has been in the news over a long dispute with Senate President Godswill Akpabio, which led to her suspension from the Senate. She has a large following and has been involved in community programmes in her district. This week she said she follows the EFCC on social media because she wants Kogi to recover funds she said were owed to the state.
## What happens next
It is not clear whether the EFCC will investigate. The senator has not publicly responded to the call.
more: The Obi–Kwankwaso Movement called for an EFCC probe.
A Kogi group says the call is politically motivated.
The EFCC has not commented.

stories.h: Makinde launches Reset Agenda, proposes sharing oil windfall with ordinary Nigerians
stories.p: APM presidential candidate Seyi Makinde has unveiled his Reset Agenda manifesto in Abuja, proposing that oil earnings above the budget benchmark go directly to citizens' welfare. His running mate, former DSS chief Lawal Musa Daura, warned that the opposition is being suppressed.
body: Oyo State governor Seyi Makinde, presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), has launched his manifesto for the 2027 election.
## The proposals

At an event at the Transcorp Hilton in Abuja on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, Makinde reportedly called for a system in which crude oil earnings above the federal budget benchmark are channelled directly into the welfare of ordinary Nigerians, arguing that citizens of such a richly endowed country have no reason to be poor. The manifesto, called the Reset Agenda, also sets out proposals on electricity, governance and electoral reform. He was joined by his running mate, Alhaji Lawal Musa Daura, and APM National Chairman Yusuf Mamman Dantalle.
## Running mate's warning
Daura, a former Director-General of the Department of State Services, reportedly warned that opposition parties were being suppressed ahead of the elections.
## Background

Makinde is completing his second term as Oyo governor, having been elected on the PDP platform. He is now running against President Bola Tinubu of the APC, Atiku Abubakar of the ADC and Peter Obi of the NDC, among others, in the presidential election scheduled for 16 January 2027. A well-known Obidient mobiliser, Serah Ibrahim, introduced him at the launch and said she helped draft the Reset Agenda. Several of his state officials have resigned in recent weeks.
## How people reacted
Makinde's supporters praised the focus on welfare and electricity, while critics questioned how the oil windfall plan would be funded and whether he could build a national base in time.
more: Makinde wants oil earnings above the benchmark to go to citizens.
His running mate is former DSS chief Lawal Musa Daura.
The presidential election is on 16 January 2027.

stories.h: Wike denies role in Okorocha judgment, asks why Uzodimma fears Rainbow Coalition
stories.p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has denied any link to the court ruling that made Rochas Okorocha the APC's Imo West Senate candidate instead of Governor Hope Uzodimma. He said Okorocha is his friend and questioned why Uzodimma is afraid of the Rainbow Coalition.
body: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has rejected suggestions that he was behind a court judgment that removed Imo State governor Hope Uzodimma as the All Progressives Congress (APC) candidate for the Imo West senatorial district.
## What Wike said

Speaking at his monthly media chat in Abuja on Thursday, 5 November 2026, Wike reportedly described claims linking him to the ruling as mischievous, saying he neither filed nor took part in the case. He pointed out that he is not a member of the APC. He said Uzodimma had earlier declared that there was no Rainbow Coalition in Imo State, which Wike called uncivilised, and that it was wrong to credit him with the judgment. He also asked why the governor was afraid of the coalition, saying both men could tell their supporters to vote for President Bola Tinubu. Wike said he owed no apology for his friendship with Okorocha, and that his main focus was the President's re-election.
## The court ruling

A Federal High Court in Abuja recently ordered INEC to publish Okorocha's name as the APC candidate for Imo West, after he argued that he won the party's primary. Uzodimma has not said publicly whether he will appeal.
## Background

The Rainbow Coalition is a group of PDP and other politicians led by Wike that backs Tinubu's re-election. It has caused friction with some APC governors, including Uzodimma, who see it as a rival structure. Okorocha governed Imo from 2011 to 2019 and has long been a rival of Uzodimma. Former APC chairman Abdullahi Ganduje visited Okorocha to congratulate him after the ruling.
more: Wike says he had no role in the Imo West ruling.
He asked why Uzodimma fears the Rainbow Coalition.
He says Okorocha is his friend.

stories.h: Christmas airfares to South-East and South-South jump by up to 208%
stories.p: Domestic economy tickets for flights around 20 and 21 December on routes from Lagos and Abuja to South-East and South-South cities have reportedly risen to between ₦196,000 and ₦337,500, increases of up to 208%. A Lagos–Benin ticket now costs about ₦310,500.
body: Nigerians planning to fly home for Christmas and the New Year face sharply higher fares, according to booking data reported on Thursday, 5 November 2026.
## The new prices

Economy tickets for flights departing on 20 and 21 December on routes linking Lagos and Abuja to cities in the South-East and South-South have reportedly risen to between ₦196,000 and ₦337,500, with some fares up by as much as 208 per cent. One airline was reportedly charging about ₦310,500 for a one-way Lagos–Benin flight, up from about ₦120,000. Air Peace, Aero Contractors and United Nigeria Airlines were among the carriers with the steepest increases.
## Why fares rise

Demand for flights to the South-East and South-South surges every December as many people travel home for the holidays. Airlines say high costs of aviation fuel, foreign exchange for maintenance and leasing, and limited aircraft numbers push up fares. Senate President Godswill Akpabio said this week that even politicians are struggling to find aircraft to hire.
## Background

The Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC) previously accused some domestic airlines of fixing prices during the 2025 festive season. Airlines denied wrongdoing and blamed operating costs. Many travellers choose road travel instead, despite security concerns on some highways.
## What it means
Consumer groups are urging regulators to monitor fares, while travel experts advise booking early to avoid the highest prices.
more: Some fares have risen by up to 208%.
Lagos–Benin now costs about ₦310,500.
The FCCPC previously accused airlines of price-fixing.

stories.h: Ambode pledges to mobilise support for Tinubu and Hamzat, plans Epe rally
stories.p: Former Lagos governor Akinwunmi Ambode has reportedly pledged to mobilise support for President Tinubu's re-election and APC Lagos governorship candidate Obafemi Hamzat. His group plans to host Hamzat and other APC candidates in Epe next week.
body: Former Lagos State governor Akinwunmi Ambode has declared that he will mobilise support for President Bola Tinubu's re-election and for Dr Obafemi Hamzat, the All Progressives Congress (APC) governorship candidate in Lagos.
## What was announced

A statement from the Ambode Support Associates, signed by former Lagos State Emergency Management Agency general manager Adesina Tiamiyu, said the decision followed a closed-door meeting between Ambode and his political allies on Wednesday, 4 November 2026. The group said it would host Hamzat and other APC candidates in Epe, Ambode's home town, next week to show party unity. It said its mobilisation drive would target grassroots communities, market women, artisans and people with disabilities across the state.
## Background

Ambode governed Lagos from 2015 to 2019 but was denied a second-term ticket by the APC after falling out with party leaders, and was succeeded by Babajide Sanwo-Olu. Hamzat, the current deputy governor, is the party's candidate to succeed Sanwo-Olu in 2027. Ambode's return to active campaigning for the party is seen as a boost to APC unity in Lagos, where opposition parties are also seeking to make gains.
## What happens next
The Epe rally is expected to take place next week, with details to be announced.
more: Ambode will mobilise support for Tinubu and Hamzat.
His group plans an Epe rally next week.
He was denied a second term in 2019.

stories.h: Akwa Ibom declares Friday work-free day for Tinubu's visit
stories.p: Akwa Ibom governor Umo Eno has declared Friday, 6 November, a work-free day ahead of a visit by President Tinubu, who is expected to commission projects including a new international terminal at Victor Attah Airport. A pro-Tinubu rally is also planned.
body: Akwa Ibom State governor Umo Eno has declared Friday, 6 November 2026, a work-free day in the state ahead of a visit by President Bola Tinubu.
## The visit

The governor made the announcement after inspecting projects lined up for commissioning during the visit, including the International Terminal Building at Victor Attah International Airport in Uyo, according to reports. He described the visit as timely and significant for the state's development and urged residents to come out and welcome the President. A rally in support of Tinubu's 2027 re-election bid is also planned.
## Background

Eno was elected governor in 2023 on the PDP platform and later joined the APC. He is one of several governors who have defected to the ruling party and endorsed the President's re-election. The visit comes shortly after Tinubu returned from Saudi Arabia, where he performed Umrah. Uyo will also host the Super Eagles' AFCON qualifier against Tanzania on 13 November.
## Reactions
Supporters welcomed the visit and the new projects.
## Two-state trip

Presidential spokesman Bayo Onanuga said the President will leave Abuja on Friday for a two-day visit to Akwa Ibom and Rivers states. After commissioning projects in Uyo, he will attend an APC rally in Port Harcourt, his third campaign outing since the start of his re-election drive.
## Security measures

Akwa Ibom police commissioner Baba Azare banned the use of drones, fireworks and other devices that could cause panic during the visit, and said access would be restricted on major roads including Airport Road, Iron Road and Ring Road III leading to the Godswill Akpabio Stadium. He urged other parties to reschedule events planned for Friday. Projects due to be inaugurated include the new terminal at Victor Attah International Airport, an Aviation Village, the Ring Road III extension and a resort park in Uyo.
## What happens next
Security is expected to be tight in Uyo during the visit.
more: Friday is a work-free day in Akwa Ibom.
Tinubu will commission projects including a new airport terminal.
A pro-Tinubu rally is planned.

stories.alt: President Bola Tinubu

stories.h: Kunle Afod speaks for the first time on separation from wife Desola
stories.p: Actor Kunle Afod has opened up about his separation from his wife, Desola Afod, pointing to jealousy and trust issues as problems in relationships, without giving a detailed account. Reports of their marriage crisis first emerged in February.
body: Nollywood actor and filmmaker Kunle Afod has spoken publicly for the first time about his separation from his wife, Desola Afod, popularly known as Celeb Wife.
## What he said

In a YouTube interview reported on Thursday, 5 November 2026, Afod was asked directly about the reasons for the separation. According to reports, he did not give a detailed account of their personal experience, but spoke more generally about jealousy, suspicions of infidelity and trust issues in relationships. He also talked about the demands of his acting career, which keep him away from home, and said there are double standards in how couples judge each other.
## Other comments
In the same interview, the actor reportedly said he can go months without calling his children, a remark that drew criticism from some fans.
## Background
Reports of trouble in the couple's marriage emerged in February 2026, after claims that Desola had moved her belongings out of their home. Desola has not publicly responded to his latest comments.
## How people reacted
Fans were divided, with some sympathising with the actor and others criticising his comments about his children and urging the couple to resolve their differences privately.
more: Afod spoke generally about jealousy and trust issues.
Reports of the crisis first emerged in February.
Desola has not responded.

stories.h: Court sacks ADC's David Mark-led leadership, voids Atiku's presidential nomination
stories.p: A Federal High Court in Abuja has reportedly removed the David Mark-led caretaker leadership of the ADC and nullified its decisions, including the nomination of Atiku Abubakar as presidential candidate. The ruling came a day after Atiku's Sokoto rally.
body: A Federal High Court in Abuja has removed the David Mark-led leadership of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and voided its decisions, including the nomination of former vice-president Atiku Abubakar as the party's 2027 presidential candidate, according to reports on Thursday, 5 November 2026.
## The judgment

Justice Peter Lifu reportedly delivered the judgment in a suit filed by Nafiu Bala Gombe, a former national deputy chairman of the ADC for the North-East. The court ruled against the caretaker committee led by former Senate President David Mark and set aside all decisions it took on behalf of the party, which would include the primary that produced Atiku as candidate. Full details of the court's reasoning and any orders to INEC were still emerging.
## Timing
The ruling came less than 24 hours after Atiku formally launched his presidential campaign at a rally in Sokoto, which his campaign said drew a large crowd.
## Background

The ADC became the platform of a coalition of opposition figures in 2025, with David Mark as interim national chairman. Its leadership has faced legal challenges from former officials who say they were wrongly pushed aside. Several court cases over party primaries are ongoing across all major parties, and courts have recently sacked candidates in Nasarawa and ordered changes elsewhere.
## Atiku responds

In a statement issued from Birnin Kebbi on Thursday through his campaign spokesman, Phrank Shaibu, Atiku condemned the ruling and described it as a deliberate attempt to derail his campaign after the large turnout at his Sokoto launch. His campaign pointed to an earlier Federal High Court ruling that had dismissed a similar challenge to the David Mark-led leadership, and said the judgment would be challenged at the Court of Appeal. It said the campaign would continue, moving on to Kebbi State.
## Party and government react

The ADC's national publicity secretary, Bolaji Abdullahi, described the judgment as legally indefensible and politically motivated, and said its timing, straight after the Sokoto rally, raised serious concerns. The party cited a ruling by another Federal High Court judge on 2 July 2026 that affirmed the David Mark-led leadership, and warned the APC against using the courts to eliminate competition. Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo welcomed the judgment, saying justice may be slow but is always sure, and rejected claims that it threatens democracy.
## What the judge ruled

According to further reports, Justice Lifu held that Mark's emergence as ADC chairman violated the party's constitution, the Electoral Act and the 1999 Constitution. The court also struck down the appointment of former Interior Minister Rauf Aregbesola as national secretary, along with other national officers and candidates the party had presented for 2027. Nafiu Bala Gombe, who filed the suit and leads a rival faction, praised the court for handling a politically sensitive case without outside influence.
## What happens next
The ADC and Atiku are widely expected to appeal. Until the appeal is decided, it is not clear how the ruling will affect his candidacy or the party's campaign.
more: The court voided all decisions of the Mark-led caretaker committee.
That includes Atiku's nomination as presidential candidate.
An appeal is widely expected.

stories.h: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football at 41
stories.p: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football, ending a 23-year career with Portugal in which he became the all-time leading scorer in men's international football. He announced it in a letter read in an Instagram video.
body: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football, bringing to an end one of the most remarkable careers in the history of the game.
## The announcement

The 41-year-old shared the news on Thursday, 5 November 2026, in an Instagram video in which he read a letter to the Portuguese people. He said the day had come to hand back the national team shirt and captain's armband, which he had never felt belonged only to him, and that the decision was made with the heart as well as the head. He described a journey that began in August 2003 and said that when he looks back he sees not only goals and trophies but the people who supported him, including Portuguese emigrants around the world.
## A record career

Ronaldo made his Portugal debut in 2003 and went on to become the most-capped player and all-time top scorer in men's international football. He led Portugal to victory at Euro 2016, their first major title, and also won the UEFA Nations League twice. He played at six World Cups.
## Club career continues
Ronaldo will continue playing for Al Nassr in Saudi Arabia. Last week he scored a hat-trick for the club, taking his career total to 985 goals, and he has said he wants to reach 1,000.
## How people reacted
Fans, players and clubs around the world paid tribute, with many calling him one of the greatest players of all time.
more: Ronaldo played for Portugal from 2003 to 2026.
He is men's international football's all-time top scorer.
He will keep playing for Al Nassr.

stories.h: NNPC cuts petrol price to ₦1,325 in Abuja and ₦1,355 in Lagos
stories.p: NNPC retail stations in Abuja are now reportedly selling petrol at ₦1,325 per litre, down from as much as ₦1,405, while Lagos stations cut prices by ₦5 to ₦1,355. The cuts follow a pricing review by the Dangote refinery.
body: Motorists in Abuja and Lagos are paying a little less for petrol after the Nigerian National Petroleum Company (NNPC) cut prices at its filling stations.
## The new prices

Checks on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, reportedly showed that NNPC stations in Abuja were selling petrol at ₦1,325 per litre, down from between ₦1,370 and ₦1,405, a reduction of ₦45 to ₦80 per litre. Stations along the Kubwa Expressway and in Gwarinpa were among those already selling at the new price. In Lagos, NNPC stations cut their price by ₦5 to ₦1,355 per litre.
## Why prices fell

The cuts followed a pricing review by the Dangote refinery and competition among depots, some of which have been selling below Dangote's ₦1,300 per litre gantry price. Depot prices across Lagos, Port Harcourt, Calabar and Warri showed mixed movements.
## Background

Petrol prices have been set by the market since the subsidy was removed in 2023, and the Dangote refinery now plays a leading role in local supply. Prices remain far higher than before the subsidy removal, and fuel costs are a major factor in transport and food prices. Global oil prices have also been affected this week by tension between the United States and Iran.
## What it means
Analysts say other marketers may follow NNPC's lead, but warn that prices could rise again if crude prices or the exchange rate move.
more: Abuja price falls to ₦1,325 per litre.
Lagos price falls by ₦5 to ₦1,355.
The cut follows a Dangote pricing review.

stories.h: Aisha Yesufu launches citizens' fundraising campaign for Peter Obi
stories.p: Activist Aisha Yesufu has called on Nigerians to donate to Peter Obi's 2027 campaign, saying it is not sustainable for Obi to fund most activities himself. She said the citizens' fund is separate from the NDC's account and promised transparency.
body: Activist Aisha Yesufu has launched a fundraising drive asking ordinary Nigerians to contribute to Peter Obi's 2027 presidential campaign.
## What she said

In a video posted on X on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, Yesufu said Obi cannot do it alone, and that people who want to take back their country must take ownership of the campaign. She argued that the arrangement in which Obi personally funds most campaign activities is no longer sustainable, and urged supporters to give whatever they can afford. She said the citizens' fund is separate from the account of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Obi's party, and promised full transparency in how the money is used.
## Background

Yesufu is a co-founder of the Bring Back Our Girls movement and one of Obi's most prominent supporters. Obi, a former Anambra governor, is running with Rabiu Kwankwaso on the NDC ticket. His campaign has presented itself as funded by ordinary citizens in contrast to what it describes as money politics. His convoy was attacked by thugs in Calabar on Wednesday. Other candidates, including President Bola Tinubu of the APC and Atiku Abubakar of the ADC, are backed by large party structures and support groups.
## Rules on campaign funding
Nigeria's Electoral Act sets limits on how much candidates can spend and how much individuals can donate, and requires parties to account for campaign funds.
## How people reacted
Obi's supporters welcomed the appeal and shared it widely, while critics questioned how the fund would be managed and audited.
more: Yesufu says Obi cannot fund the campaign alone.
The citizens' fund is separate from the NDC account.
She promised full transparency.
